requirement:
Only records whose captured source inputs match the current project source and
whose build configurations are compatible MAY contribute execution counts to
the combined view of {cite}`requirements.test-coverage.index.selection`.
Records invalidated by a source change, or whose compatibility cannot be
established, MUST be identified as stale or unavailable and excluded from the
combined coverage totals. Their retained per-process reports MUST remain
inspectable using their captured source until the build artifacts are removed.
rationale:
I found no gaps. The code carries out each obligation and a test covers each one.

**Implementation.** `src/execution_coverage/book.rs#fn[populate]` has the {impl} reference. It delegates to `populate_in`, which is therefore reachable. `populate_in` calls `fresh` in `src/execution_coverage.rs#fn[fresh]`.

**Only matching, compatible records contribute.**
- `fresh` returns false if the schema is not 1, if any workspace input digest differs, added or removed, if any recorded input digest differs, or if a non-Cargo-derived build environment input differs.
- `populate_in` stores that result as `Record.fresh`. Totals come only from selected records that pass `record.fresh && readable(record) && !uncertain_history`.
- Compatibility is handled by the configuration check. Only records whose `run.configuration` equals the active configuration are selected, and the rest are labelled "excluded: historical build configuration".
- Unsupported schemas and unreadable history set `uncertain_history`, which removes all records from the totals.

**Stale or unavailable records are identified and excluded.** The state column shows these labels:
- "stale: source inputs changed or unavailable"
- "unavailable: incomplete coverage"
- "unavailable: latest attempt history cannot be established"

None of these records reaches `union`, so they add nothing to the totals.

**Retained reports stay inspectable.** `populate_in` builds a detail chapter for every record, stale or not. It also builds a "Captured source" chapter for every run from `run.sources`, regardless of freshness.

**Tests that run the code and assert outcomes.**
- `filtered_runs_union_latest_attempts_and_invalidate_with_saved_source` changes `code.rs` and asserts the "no fresh instrumented lines" and "stale: source inputs changed or unavailable" labels. It asserts that the captured source `fn one() {}` is still rendered. It also asserts that a record from another build configuration is labelled "historical build configuration".
- `unreadable_history_cannot_reintroduce_an_older_success` covers three unavailable cases: unsupported schema, missing captured source, and missing raw profile. In each case the record is shown as unavailable and excluded from the totals.
- `cargo_launch_metadata_does_not_invalidate_but_caller_build_environment_does` checks that Cargo-derived launch variables do not make a record stale. It also checks that changing a caller build variable (`CC`, `RUSTFLAGS` and others) does.
- `src/execution_coverage.rs#fn[source_and_build_inputs_invalidate_on_addition_removal_and_dirty_content]` exercises `fresh` directly. It covers changed, added and removed source and build inputs.

All of these tests carry {test} references to the subject.

The text names no behavior that the code leaves unspecified.

:::{req} index.selection
The coverage index MUST combine the most recent recorded test attempt for each
nextest binary and test name among the retained runs. "Most recent" MUST refer
to when the attempt started, including failed or interrupted attempts. A newer
filtered run MUST update only the tests it executes, leaving other compatible
test records available to the combined view. A newer attempt with missing or
unreadable coverage MUST be shown as unavailable rather than replaced with an
older successful attempt. Results from incompatible instrumented build
configurations MUST NOT be combined under
{cite}`requirements.test-coverage.storage.configuration`.
The main combined view MUST use the instrumented build configuration of the
most recently started recorded test attempt. Latest-per-test selection MUST
occur within that configuration. Records from other configurations MUST be
identified as excluded historical coverage. Configuration selection MUST use
recorded metadata without building or executing tests.
